precheck: Check _queue_code_signature_targets includes resources.d/display/* and resources.d/xml/* as well as localized */* payloads
text: Installed display/xml manifest files sit at resources.d/display/manifest.example.tsv and resources.d/xml/manifest.example.tsv, so signature target patterns that only match resources.d/display/*/* or resources.d/xml/*/* cover localized payloads but miss top-level manifest files. Include both one-level and two-level resource patterns in installed share-tree signing.
